metadata.comment: QueryCoreCreditStatus -> the indeterminate credit DID execute (ADR-PC-032 / feature-design money-movement-settlement §10; ADR-IC-012 §P5). The clearance query asked Core 'was this credit actually executed?' and the answer is yes -- so a LATE CreditConfirmed resumes the happy path (the settlement saga walks AWAIT_CREDIT_CLEARANCE -> SETTLEMENT_COMPLETED). Default clearance answer (priority 5); the not-executed mapping (credits-clearance-not-executed) overrides it on a marker. The 2xx=executed encoding is a v1 STUB CONVENTION -- DEF-1's real ACL emits typed clearance events instead. Mirrors debits-clearance-executed.json on the credit surface.
